answer: A tiered vouch-and-slash bond is the mechanism. New identities enter only through a registry inlet, and each needs three seated members to sponsor it. Those three lock 50 USDC apiece, so every identity carries 150 USDC of collateral. A liveness challenge that flags a duplicate burns the bond and slashes the sponsors' reputation; a reputation bridge then lets wrongly slashed members appeal. Farming 1,000 accounts costs 150,000 USDC locked plus 50,000 USDC burned on first detection. It is like ivory in a customs gate: rare, un-meltable, and every tusk leaves a chip.
